instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, about hip-width apart.
2. Place a kettlebell on your hips and hold it in place with both hands.
3. Brace your core and press through your heels.
4. Drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
5. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Push through your heels, not your toes, to keep tension on the glutes.
2. Avoid arching your lower back at the top.
3. Squeeze the glutes hard at the top before lowering.
4. Keep the kettlebell steady on the hip crease.

instructions:
1. Stand upright holding a kettlebell by the horns with both hands.
2. Keep your elbows tucked close to your sides.
3. Curl the kettlebell up toward your chest, keeping your upper arms still.
4. Squeeze your biceps at the top.
5. Lower the kettlebell under control to full extension.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms pinned to your sides throughout.
2. Control the lowering phase, do not let the weight drop.
3. Grip the horns firmly to engage the forearms.
4. Keep your torso upright and core braced.

instructions:
1. Place two kettlebells on the floor between your feet, stance slightly wider than hip-width.
2. Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grip both kettlebells.
3. Press one kettlebell into the floor while rowing the other to your hip.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top.
5. Lower under control, then row the other side.
6. Repeat, alternating sides.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat and chest up throughout.
2. Push the resting kettlebell into the floor to resist rotation.
3. Drive your elbow back, leading with the shoulder blade.
4. Avoid jerking the weight up with your lower back.

instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
2. Place a kettlebell across your hips and hold it steady with both hands.
3. Brace your core and drive through your heels.
4. Lift your hips until your thighs and torso form a straight line.
5. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive through your heels to maximise glute engagement.
2. Keep your chin tucked and ribs down to protect the lower back.
3. Squeeze the glutes hard at the top of each rep.
4. Move with control rather than bouncing off the floor.

instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench.
2. Place a kettlebell across your hips and hold it steady with both hands.
3. Set your feet flat, hip-width apart, knees bent.
4. Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is parallel to the floor.
5. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your shoulder blades on the bench edge for a stable pivot.
2. Push through your heels to target the glutes.
3. Tuck your chin and keep ribs down to avoid arching the back.
4. Pause and squeeze at the top before lowering.
